measurement_notes: 2026-09-25 pilot-entry profile. AGY 1.2.11 and model-list evidence are captured; a dedicated wrapper backs up global settings/instructions/hooks, applies the scoped policy, runs one child, and restores original bytes. AGY may sparsely omit documented default settings, so semantic defaults are accepted while a changed allow list is rejected. Runner checks that scope before launch and disables auto-update for AGY child processes. No model inference occurred in preflight; entitlement, actual command matching, init permission mode, usage and soft-denial are first-pilot observations, not preflight pass claims. Run only through the wrapper after receipt and R10 conditions are met.
